author: asukhobo
title: Windows GPU unit tests job fails extracting OpenVINO packages due to locked tbb12.dll
signature: windows runner extract openvino packages expand-archive remove-item access to the path denied unauthorizedaccessexception locked dll file|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step failed: Expand-Archive could not overwrite tbb12.dll because PowerShell's Remove-Item raised UnauthorizedAccessException (file locked/permission denied).

key_errors:
Remove-Item : Cannot remove item C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll:
Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied.
At C:\Windows\system32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules\Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive\Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive.psm1:1029
+ CategoryInfo          : PermissionDenied: (C:\actions-runn...b\bin\tbb12.dll:FileInfo) [Remove-Item], UnauthorizedAccessException
+ FullyQualifiedErrorId : RemoveFileSystemItemUnAuthorizedAccess,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.RemoveItemCommand
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
root_cause: The 'GPU unit tests' job's 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step runs Expand-Archive -Force against an install directory on a Windows self-hosted runner that still has tbb12.dll locked from a prior process/step (likely AV scanning or a stale handle left over from a previous job on a reused runner). Expand-Archive's internal Remove-Item call then fails with UnauthorizedAccessException. The triggering commit (#39617, an NPU engineering-drop update unrelated to packaging/extraction) is not the cause; this is the 6th occurrence of the identical signature within roughly 23 hours, confirming an unresolved recurring Windows-runner infrastructure issue rather than a code regression.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reliably reproducible outside CI. Requires the specific Windows self-hosted runner state with a locked tbb12.dll handle (e.g. an AV scanner or a stale process from a previous job holding the file open) immediately before the Expand-Archive step runs.
recommended_actions: Escalate the recurring tbb12.dll lock issue (6th occurrence in ~23 hours) to the CI infrastructure team to investigate stale processes/AV locks on the Windows self-hosted runner pool used for GPU unit tests.
Add a retry-with-delay wrapper around the Expand-Archive/Remove-Item extraction step for Windows jobs, or switch to a 7zip/robocopy-based extraction that tolerates locked destination files.
Ensure prior steps/processes that load tbb12.dll (e.g. a leftover test process) are fully terminated before the extraction step runs, and consider recycling the runner image between jobs.
prevention_strategies: Wrap Windows archive-extraction steps with a retry loop when Remove-Item/Expand-Archive fails with UnauthorizedAccessException, and recycle Windows self-hosted runner images periodically to clear stale locked handles left by prior jobs/processes.
historical_context: Signature 514ffa2ab52ad344 (tbb12.dll extraction lock) was previously recorded 5 times between 2026-11-09T16:30:00Z and 2026-11-10T13:33:59Z (runs 42626586527, 42775441636, 42783108480, 42807973464, 42814866016). This run is the 6th occurrence within roughly 23 hours, strongly confirming an unresolved, recurring Windows-runner infrastructure issue that has not yet been fixed despite repeated prior reports.
